children: reports that it has engaged Metallis Partners Pty Ltd. ("Metallis"), a Sydney-based resources transaction advisory firm, to evaluate strategic options for EU Gold's interests in various exploration and mining permits in Côte d'Ivoire.

Metallis is a corporate advisory firm specialising in mergers, acquisitions and divestments in the resources sector. Metallis runs structured, competitive sale processes for private and listed mining companies seeking to monetise non-core or undervalued assets, drawing on an active buyer network across the ASX, TSX/TSXV and AIM markets. The firm has particular depth in the Australian and Canadian junior markets and a notable track record of completing asset transactions in emerging jurisdictions across gold, copper and critical minerals.

Metallis works with a number of funded listed companies, IPO vehicles and growth groups looking at West African gold, and Côte d'Ivoire has been a focus for several of them. Metallis' mandate will include evaluating a range of potential transaction pathways for EU Gold, including strategic partnerships and potential transactions with an ASX-listed group.

EU Gold Mining is engaged in the exploration and development of its mineral property interests in Côote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company recently acquired several gold permit and permit applications covering a total of 1,393 square kilometres, including the Kimoukro Gold Project consisting of 14.47 square kilometres.
